question: The technical completion of the current maintenance order was posted with a delay of 5 days. What happens to the next planned date if you set the shift factor for early completion to 100%? A. It is postponed by a full cycle (100%). B. It is postponed by 5 days. C. It is not shifted. D. It will be 5 days earlier.

Which of the following parameters are available when you define a new maintenance plan category? (Choose three.) A. Completion date B. Call object C. Change documents D. Order type E. Maintenance activity type

You want to create a single-cycle plan with a cycle of 12 months. You use the scheduling indicator Time - key date. The orders should be called 3 months before the planned date. How can you set up the maintenance plan? (Choose two.) A. Set the call horizon to 90 days. B. Set the call horizon to 25%. C. Set the call horizon to 75%. D. Set the offset to 3 months.
You create two maintenance packages and only one package should be executed at a time. Which parameter determines this? A. Lead flow B. Hierarchy C. Cycle set sequence D. Package sequence

You want to assign components to an equipment task list. There is no BOM assigned to the equipment. What is the prerequisite for using the free assignment of material? A. Assign the header material of a material BOM to the equipment task list header. B. Assign the BOM usage for free assignment of material in Customizing. C. Assign the header material of a material BOM as assembly to a task list operation. D. Free assignment of material is always possible without any prerequisites.

You want to see historical information relating to the phases when equipment was installed at a functional location. Where can you find this information? A. Object Statistics B. Structure Display C. Location Analysis List D. Usage List

You want to view transactional and analytical processing data in the Technical Object Breakdowns app. What is the source of the information? A. Core Data Service View B. BW InfoCube C. PMIS InfoSet D. SAP Query InfoSet

Which of the following statements about SAP Asset Manager are true? (Choose three.) A. SAP Asset Manager is available for SAP S/4HANA and SAP ERP. B. SAP Asset Manager can run on smart watches. C. SAP Asset Manager provides single sign-on functionality. D. SAP Asset Manager can be used offline. E. SAP Asset Manager is available only for the iOS platform.

Which statements about the structure indicator are correct? (Choose two.) A. It defines which data is transferred to the lower levels of the hierarchy. B. It defines the allowed characters for a functional location. C. It can have a maximum length of 50 characters. D. It defines hierarchy levels of the functional location structure.

Which objects have been enhanced with linear data in maintenance processes? (Choose three.) A. Maintenance plan header B. Work order confirmation C. Measurement document D. Maintenance plan item E. Equipment task list

You are analyzing the data transfer of the cost center of a piece of equipment. What are the possible data origins? (Choose two.) A. The individual maintenance of the cost center in the equipment master record B. The cost center of the superior equipment C. The cost center of the related maintenance work center D. The reference functional location of the superior functional location

You want to create a new functional location. Which configuration steps are required? (Choose two.) A. Define the structure indicator. B. Define the reference functional location. C. Define the number range for the functional location category. D. Define the functional location category.

You want to display vehicle-specific data for a piece of equipment. How do you proceed? A. Assign a view profile to an equipment category for fleet equipment. B. Define the field selection for the vehicle equipment master data. C. Assign a view profile to the combination of fleet object type and equipment category. D. Assign a view profile to the combination of equipment category and vehicle class.
Which of the following can you assign to an equipment category via a view profile? (Choose two.) A. Warranty B. Serial data C. Configuration D. Manufacturer data

You need to create a new functional location. Which actions can you perform with the SAP Fiori app “Create Technical Object”? (Choose three.) A. Create a task list for functional location. B. Assign a subordinate piece of equipment. C. Assign documents. D. Change a reference location. E. Edit classification data and characteristics.
What is a valid partner type within the partner determination procedure? A. Business partner (gen.) B. Vendor (external) C. Planner group D. Purchasing organization

How does the work center influence cost calculation in the maintenance order? (Choose two.) A. Via cost center and activity type B. Via business partner and hourly price C. Via activity type and hourly rate D. Via organizational unit and personal hourly rate

You want to assign a maintenance planning plant directly to an organizational unit. Which of the following units can you use? A. Maintenance planner groups B. Controlling area C. Maintenance work center D. Location

Which of the following statements about orders with operation account assignment (OAA) are correct? (Choose three.) A. The settlement rule is maintained on the header level. B. Purchase requisitions have the operation as account assignment. C. A technical object must be assigned to an order operation. D. Costs are stored only for the operation object. E. Overall costs are dynamically summed up on the header level.

You cancel the technical completion of a work order. What are the effects? (Choose two.) A. Referenced notifications are put In Process again. B. Open purchase orders are recompiled. C. Open reservations are recompiled. D. Open purchase requisitions are recompiled.

Where can you see the results of the material availability check for maintenance orders? (Choose two.) A. Within a maintenance order B. In the material reservation list in inventory management C. In the list editing (single-level) for maintenance orders D. In the report Material: Where-Used List

Where can the maintenance planner perform a material availability check? (Choose two.) A. Via the SAP Fiori app “Manage Maintenance Order List” B. Via the multi-level order list (SAP GUI) C. Via the SAP Fiori app “Maintenance Scheduling Board” D. Within the SAP Fiori-based background job

Which statements related to the creation of maintenance orders are correct? (Choose two.) A. The document within the document management system can be assigned only at operational level. B. When an order is created based on a single notification, this notification becomes the header notification. C. The long text of the reference notification can be automatically copied as the long text of the order. D. The assignment of the header notification to an order CANNOT be deleted.

Which statements regarding a maintenance order with status REL are correct? (Choose three.) A. Goods receipts for external services can be entered. B. The planner can change planned costs at the operation level. C. Shop papers can be printed only after the order release. D. The controller can determine actual cost surcharges. E. The planner can change estimated costs only at the header level.
What can you assign in a notification item? (Choose two.) A. Only one cause of damage B. Only one object part C. One or more causes of damage D. One or more object parts

Which operations are possible when you cancel the technical completion of a maintenance order? (Choose two.) A. Cancel status Released. B. Change the priority. C. Change the estimated costs. D. Book a goods receipt.
Which SAP UI technology is used for the Report and Repair Malfunction app? A. Web Dynpro B. SAPUI5 C. SAP GUI for Windows D. SAP GUI for HTML

Which statements are correct about UI technologies in SAP S/4HANA Asset Management? (Choose two.) A. SAP Fiori launchpad supports only SAPUI5 apps. B. Web Dynpro apps can be used in the SAP Fiori launchpad. C. SAP GUI transactions can be used in the SAP Fiori launchpad. D. The cloud version can also use SAP GUI for Windows.

Which statement is correct about the SAP Fiori tile group? (Choose two.) A. It is based on an SAP Fiori tile catalog. B. It is assigned via a portal role. C. It can be assigned directly to the user via personalization. D. It provides only SAPUI5-based apps.

How do you set up the visible tiles for a specific user in SAP Fiori launchpad? (Choose two.) A. By assigning the tiles directly B. By assigning a PFCG role with an SAP Fiori catalog C. By assigning a PFCG role with an SAP Fiori tile group D. By assigning a portal role with an SAP Fiori catalog

Which of the following statements about breakdown maintenance are correct? (Choose three.) A. More than one operation must always be maintained in the maintenance order. B. Orders and notifications can be used in combination. C. Notifications are used for documentation of technical findings and activities performed. D. Maintenance orders can be created as immediate orders without any planning. E. Orders always need to be combined with notifications.

Which statements are correct for standard processes in PM/PS cost control? (Choose two.) A. Maintenance costs can be settled to a network operation. B. Budget can be assigned to a WBS element. C. Maintenance order costs can be settled to a WBS element. D. Budget can be assigned to a maintenance plan.

You create a revision for a Maintenance Event Builder (MEB) scenario. Which of the following statements are correct? (Choose two.) A. You must assign maintenance notifications to the revision. B. You can assign a hierarchical task list to the revision. C. You can assign a network to a revision. D. You must use hierarchical task lists for the MEB scenario.
Which valuation category do you use to refurbish a material? A. Origin B. In-house/external procurement C. Retail D. Condition-based
